raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Enrolls the remaining Compile, PyTorch, CUDA and ABI jobs in `automatic_shard`: 29 jobs (15 steps and 14 AMD mirrors). Part of a series that enrolls every remaining test step, split by test area for review. No commands change.

## Claims

| Step | Plan | AMD mirror |
|---|---|---|
| `fusion-e2e-tp2-b200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `fusion-e2e-tp2-ar-rms-config-sweep-h100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `distributed-compile-unit-tests-2xh100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `fusion-e2e-tp2-quick-h100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `fusion-and-compile-unit-tests-2xb200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `fusion-e2e-quick-h100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `fusion-e2e-config-sweep-h100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `pytorch-fullgraph-cudagraph-l4-compatibility` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `pytorch-compilation-unit-tests-h100` | 1 job (not plain pytest) | 1 shard |
| `pytorch-compilation-dynamic-shapes` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `pytorch-nightly-dependency-override-check` | 1 job (not plain pytest) | 1 job (not plain pytest) |
| `flashinfer-nvfp4-xqa-dgx-spark` | 1 shard | none |
| `torch-stable-abi-audit` | 1 job (not plain pytest) | none |
| `jit-monitor-no-runtime-jit` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `platform-tests` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `cudagraph` | already enrolled | 1 shard |

- One-shard and one-job plans run the same tests as on main, as one job, and split by themselves once their tests grow.


## Validation

- Planned each step and mirror with ci-infra main's planner against main's timings; every plan is within 10% of the same plan run as one job.
- The sharding harness (each shard's commands run against a mock test tree, as a PR build and as main with the OTel wrapper) shows every test runs exactly once wherever a plan has 2 or more shards.
- Every step and mirror passes on recent main runs, nightly included.
- `/ci run` (98460) plus a scoped build (98471) for the optional steps and AMD mirrors on this head: every enrolled job passed, and every shard finished under 22 minutes.

## Details

- **Not plain pytest** steps (shell scripts, `torchrun`, examples) and standalone AMD steps are enrolled too; the generator keeps them as one job.
- **caplog.** Files that assert on logs sit in one-shard plans here, so their order in the process doesn't change.
- **Timeouts unchanged.** `timeout_in_minutes` stays per job. Fallback-aware timeouts belong in a central timeout setting.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>
